We have pre-built skills, but you can build your own to tailor OpenSEO to your needs. ## Hosted Version Try OpenSEO for free on our website. If you want to support the project, a hosted subscription is $10/month. [openseo.so](https://openseo.so) ## Why use OpenSEO? - Best in class MCP and AI Skills. - Modern, simple UI. - Focused workflows instead of a bloated, complex SEO suite. - No subscriptions. - Bring your own DataForSEO API key and pay only for what you use. - Fork and vibe code your own custom tool. ## Main SEO Workflows - Keyword research - Rank tracking - Competitor Insights - Backlinks - Site Audits - AI Visibility ## OpenSEO MCP & Agent Skills OpenSEO exposes an MCP server so AI agents like Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Hermes can use your SEO data directly. Agent Skills are reusable workflows that guide your agent through SEO tasks using the MCP. - [Set up ChatGPT web or desktop](https://openseo.so/docs/chatgpt) (works on Free and paid ChatGPT plans) - [Set up Codex](https://openseo.so/docs/codex-plugin) - [Set up OpenSEO MCP](https://openseo.so/docs/mcp) - [Set up OpenSEO Agent Skills](https://openseo.so/docs/skills/setup) ## Self-Hosting OpenSEO supports two self-hosting paths: - **Simple: Docker (Best for testing it out)** - For personal use on your own machine. See [`docs/SELF_HOSTING_DOCKER.md`](./docs/SELF_HOSTING_DOCKER.md). - Unless you already are self-hosting other apps and are confident doing so, we recommend self-hosting with Cloudflare as opposed to Railway, Coolify or Dokploy. - We plan to make it simpler to host on those platforms in the next few months. - **Recommended: Cloudflare** - For internet-facing self-hosting across multiple devices or with your team (works on the free plan). See [`docs/DATAFORSEO_API_KEY.md`](./docs/DATAFORSEO_API_KEY.md). ## Costs OpenSEO needs a [DataForSEO](https://dataforseo.com/?aff=255379) API key so that you can get SEO data. You pay them directly when self hosting. See [openseo.so/pricing](https://openseo.so/pricing) When you self host, your costs will be slightly lower than the estimates on our website. The way the hosted service makes money is by charging 28% extra for every request we make to DataForSEO. ## Local Development See [`docs/LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT.md`](./docs/LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT.md). ## Contributing Creating clear issues is the best way to contribute. Read more here: [`docs/CONTRIBUTING.md`](./docs/CONTRIBUTING.md) We have this skill: `/simple-issue-description` which helps. ```sh npx skills add every-app/open-seo --skill simple-issue-description ``` ## Community Join Discord to chat: [Discord](https://discord.gg/c9uGs3cFXr) Follow along for updates: - Follow on X: https://x.com/bensenescu - Sign up for the mailing list on our website: [openseo.so](https://openseo.so)

aiSummary.oneLiner: Open-source, pay-as-you-go alternative to heavy SEO suites like Semrush and Ahrefs.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: OpenSEO is an all-in-one SEO tool designed for individual users and AI agents to perform focused search engine optimization workflows. Instead of locking users into expensive monthly subscriptions, it utilizes a bring-your-own-key model with DataForSEO to provide granular, pay-as-you-go data access. The platform features a modern web UI for tasks like keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, and backlink analysis. Crucially, it exposes a built-in Model Context Protocol server, allowing AI agents like Claude Code or OpenClaw to directly interact with live SEO data and execute pre-built agent skills. It supports both simple Docker deployments and advanced internet-facing Cloudflare setups for easy self-hosting.
keyFeatures: Pay-As-You-Go Architecture: Operates on a bring-your-own-key model using DataForSEO, eliminating expensive recurring subscriptions.
Native MCP Server: Exposes live SEO data directly to AI agents via the Model Context Protocol for automated workflows.
Comprehensive SEO Workflows: Includes dedicated tools for keyword research, backlink analysis, site audits, and rank tracking.
AI Agent Skills: Provides pre-built skills that guide compatible AI agents through complex SEO analysis tasks.
Flexible Self-Hosting: Supports local deployment via Docker or secure, internet-facing hosting using Cloudflare.

releases.name: v0.1.13
releases.body:
Mobile SERPs in MCP, rank tracking fixes, and clearer Search Console errors.

## What's new

- Check mobile results and organic rank with the `get_serp_results` MCP tool
- Shopify crawler signatures work past the homepage
  - Requires `CRAWLER_ACCESS_SECRET` (32+ characters), then save your signature again

## Fixed

- Incomplete rank checks no longer look like lost rankings.
- Claude no longer reports "no data" from MCP tools that returned results.
- Self-hosted site audits show start times in your timezone instead of UTC. — thanks @zigojacko2
- Search Console shows what to fix instead of "Connection expired" when a permission is missing or its API isn't enabled.
- The project switcher shows all your projects after you switch.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/every-app/open-seo/compare/v0.1.12...v0.1.13

releases.name: v0.1.12
releases.body:
Website monitoring dashboard, Claude and Perplexity tracking, and faster Run now checks.

## What's new

- A dashboard for monitoring your saved website
  - Saving a website starts a site audit automatically
- Track Claude and Perplexity in Prompt Tracking
  - Their answers cost more than the other engines
- Run now in Prompt Tracking returns answers in minutes
- See the prompts behind each citation on the Citations tab
- Move tracked prompts between topics and rename topics

## Fixed

- Claude answers in Prompt Explorer work again.
- The site audit Pages tab no longer crashes on large audits.
- Website setup no longer fails when search is briefly unavailable.
- Exporting a large prompt tracker no longer gets stuck in progress.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/every-app/open-seo/compare/v0.1.11...v0.1.12

releases.name: v0.1.11
releases.body:
AI Visibility, JavaScript site audits and rank tracking shortcuts.

## What's new

- (Beta) AI Visibility research and tracking - generic brand names can produce false mentions.
  - Track answers from ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overviews
- Render JavaScript in site audits
- Pin keywords to the top of Rank Tracking
- Open Google results from Rank Tracking

## Fixed

- Rank Tracking no longer freezes when configuring, adding keywords or selecting rows.
- Rank comparisons use the correct previous check.
- Site audits report bot challenges as blocked pages instead of missing content.
- Site audits recognize descriptions and robots tags written with capital letters.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/every-app/open-seo/compare/v0.1.10...v0.1.11

releases.name: v0.1.10
releases.body:
Group similar keywords and search by city in Keyword Research. Also, a refreshed dark mode look + more.

## What's new

- Refreshed the app's look
  - Dark mode looks better
  - Pages load smoother
- City and county search volume in Keyword Research and MCP
- Keyword Research leaves out close variants unless "Group keywords" is on
- Pick the day and time scheduled rank checks run
- Let site audits through Shopify with a crawler access signature
  - Requires `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET` (32+ characters)

## Fixed

- Location search no longer cuts off same-named towns, like Springfield, Mo.
- Rank tracking charts and history update when a check finishes, without a reload.
- New site audits show up in the audit list without a reload.
- ChatGPT answers in Prompt Explorer no longer come back without sources.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/every-app/open-seo/compare/v0.1.9...v0.1.10

releases.name: v0.1.9
releases.body:
Saved reports, reusable report templates and Search Console filters.

## What's new

- Save reports from Claude Code, Codex and other MCP clients inside a project
  - Read them in the app or export to PDF
- Create reusable report templates per project
- Filter Search Console results by position and impressions through MCP

## Fixed

- Rank tracking rejects unsupported locations when you save a tracker.
- Rank checks now show a failure when no keywords could be checked.
- Rank-tracking location searches recognize US state abbreviations and prioritize matching cities.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/every-app/open-seo/compare/v0.1.8...v0.1.9

readmeHtml:
OpenSEO

Open source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs

OpenSEO is an SEO tool for the people. If tools like Semrush or Ahrefs are too expensive or bloated, OpenSEO is a pay-as-you-go alternative that you actually control.

All-in-one SEO tool for you and your AI agent.

Connect with any agent like Claude Code, OpenClaw or Hermes. We have pre-built skills, but you can build your own to tailor OpenSEO to your needs.

Hosted Version

Try OpenSEO for free on our website. If you want to support the project, a hosted subscription is $10/month.

openseo.so

Why use OpenSEO?

  • Best in class MCP and AI Skills.
  • Modern, simple UI.
    • Focused workflows instead of a bloated, complex SEO suite.
  • No subscriptions.
    • Bring your own DataForSEO API key and pay only for what you use.
  • Fork and vibe code your own custom tool.

Main SEO Workflows

  • Keyword research
  • Rank tracking
  • Competitor Insights
  • Backlinks
  • Site Audits
  • AI Visibility

OpenSEO MCP & Agent Skills

OpenSEO exposes an MCP server so AI agents like Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Hermes can use your SEO data directly. Agent Skills are reusable workflows that guide your agent through SEO tasks using the MCP.

  • Set up ChatGPT web or desktop (works on Free and paid ChatGPT plans)
  • Set up Codex
  • Set up OpenSEO MCP
  • Set up OpenSEO Agent Skills

Self-Hosting

OpenSEO supports two self-hosting paths:

  • Simple: Docker (Best for testing it out) - For personal use on your own machine. See docs/SELF_HOSTING_DOCKER.md.
    • Unless you already are self-hosting other apps and are confident doing so, we recommend self-hosting with Cloudflare as opposed to Railway, Coolify or Dokploy.
    • We plan to make it simpler to host on those platforms in the next few months.
  • Recommended: Cloudflare - For internet-facing self-hosting across multiple devices or with your team (works on the free plan). See docs/SELF_HOSTING_CLOUDFLARE.md.

Either way, you need a DataForSEO API key to get SEO data. See docs/DATAFORSEO_API_KEY.md.

Costs

OpenSEO needs a DataForSEO API key so that you can get SEO data. You pay them directly when self hosting.

See openseo.so/pricing

When you self host, your costs will be slightly lower than the estimates on our website. The way the hosted service makes money is by charging 28% extra for every request we make to DataForSEO.

Local Development

See docs/LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT.md.

Contributing

Creating clear issues is the best way to contribute.

Read more here: docs/CONTRIBUTING.md

We have this skill: /simple-issue-description which helps.

npx skills add every-app/open-seo --skill simple-issue-description

Community

Join Discord to chat: Discord

Follow along for updates:

  • Follow on X: https://x.com/bensenescu
  • Sign up for the mailing list on our website: openseo.so
